tonight.headline: Wilson is active — nothing left to set
body: Bad news first: Diggs' 20.3 is still on your bench, and Garrett Wilson has to beat it from the WR slot. And this morning you dropped Tyler Allgeier for Jaylen Waddle (13:47Z) — Waddle is on Denver's bye and in the concussion protocol from Week 9, so he adds nothing this week and Week 11 depends on his clearance.

The 10:30 lists went your way: Wilson is officially active (NBC Sports 16:40Z), so the contingency is closed, and Boston and Etienne are active too. Minnesota ruled out Jordan Addison, so Jefferson plays with Price, Felton and a practice-squad call-up beside him. ESPN: 148.1 projected to 104.1, 75%. The lineup as set is the projection lineup. Nothing to tap.

case.label: Their side
case.body: Nicky Jam have 28.96 banked — Daniels' 20.8 plus A.J. Brown in Munich, which is under way. Bijan Robinson is their biggest remaining number; Coker sits on their bench.

case.label: The one late check
case.body: Warren and Metcalf play Sunday night at Cincinnati; that list lands at 18:00 CDMX. Neither is on the Steelers' report — Freiermuth (illness) is. Warren sits in an RB slot, so as set no bench player could replace him that late; the Do-first card fixes that for free.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A Warren inactive at 18:00 CDMX with the slots unchanged costs about 15.6 projected points; with the slot swap, Metcalf (10.6) covers. ESPN's margin is 44, so the matchup survives either way.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Before Gordon locks · Sun 15 Nov 12:00 CDMX
doFirst.title: Move Warren to FLEX and Gordon to RB
doFirst.subtitle: Same nine starters, same 132.7 projected. It keeps Metcalf as Sunday-night cover for Warren.

case.label: The problem
case.body: Warren (PIT, 19:20 CDMX) is in an RB slot and Gordon (MIA, noon) in FLEX. Chem's FLEX takes RB or WR; the RB slots take only backs. Every bench back plays at noon, so if Warren were a surprise inactive at 18:00, nobody could take his slot.

case.label: The fix
case.body: Swap the two slots in ESPN before noon. Then a Warren scratch is covered by DK Metcalf (10.6), who also plays Sunday night. Nothing else changes.

case.label: The odds
case.body: Small: Warren has no designation and is not on the Steelers' report (steelers.com 14 Nov). This is insurance that costs nothing, not a forecast.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Nothing to falsify on points — the projected total is identical either way. It was wasted effort only if the slot is never needed, which is the likely case.

whatWentWrong.title: Diggs scored 20.3 on the bench
whatWentWrong.lead: Tuesday's swap put Wilson in on a 2.0 projection edge; Diggs then drew 10 targets. Wilson now needs 20.3.

case.label: What happened
case.body: Wilson 12.8 against Diggs 10.8 on Tuesday — exactly 2.0, labelled PROJECTION. Diggs: 10 targets, 6 catches, 20.3 (archive).

case.label: Why it was still the call
case.body: Diggs played Thursday, so the slot had to be set before Wilson's concussion was decided. The projection lineup is the policy; nothing in the backtest beats it.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Wilson scores 20.3 or more — then the swap closes RIGHT. Below it, WRONG on the outcome. One decision, not a pattern.

whatWentWrong.title: Allgeier dropped for a receiver on bye
whatWentWrong.lead: Your 13:47Z move: Allgeier off, Waddle on. Waddle cannot score this week and has a concussion to clear.

case.label: The move
case.body: Allgeier (8.7, ARI vs LAR) was dropped for Waddle, whom another IPADE manager released at the same minute. Waddle left Week 9 with a concussion after one catch (NBC 8 Nov) and Denver are on bye in Week 10.

case.label: Why it is defensible
case.body: Bam Knight cleared the protocol and a 'near-even split' with Allgeier was expected (NBC 13 Nov), and Allgeier could not reach your lineup over Tuten, Gordon and Warren. Waddle was 26-30% of Denver's targets in Weeks 6-8 (archive) — a starter-grade role if healthy.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Waddle misses Week 11 with the concussion, or Allgeier outscores Waddle in two of Weeks 10-12 (archive). Logged in the decision log as your move.
